{{Quote|Fluggy will undergo the procedure tomorrow and should be back at practice with the team in five or six days, [...] His original arm will likely be donated to the hi-lo hall of fame.|Guire Sleazebaggano|<ref name="HNN51">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|sports/13411_2.html|Flugg Opts for New Arm}}</ref>}}
'''Garcy Flugg''', also known as '''Fluggy''', was a [[hi-lo ball]] hurler. After Flugg missed fifteen matches in two years due to chronic elbow injuries, his agent [[Guire Sleazebaggano]] informed the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] of Flugg's decision to replace his injured [[Limb/Legends|arm]] with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|mechanical]] one.
